fewShots.question: Which campaigns generated the most revenue and what was their ROAS?
fewShots.query: EVALUATE TOPN(10, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Campaign'[Campaign Name], "Revenue", [Total Revenue], "Spend", [Total Spend], "ROAS", [Return on Ad Spend]), [Revenue], DESC)

fewShots.question: Compare spend, leads, CPL, and conversion rate by marketing platform.
fewShots.query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Channel'[Platform], "Spend", [Total Spend], "Leads", [Total Leads], "CPL", [Cost per Lead], "Conversion Rate", [Conversion Rate]) ORDER BY [Spend] DESC

fewShots.question: Show monthly impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, and revenue.
fewShots.query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Date'[Year], 'Date'[Month Number], 'Date'[Month], "Impressions", [Total Impressions], "Clicks", [Total Clicks], "CTR", [Click-Through Rate], "CPC", [Cost per Click], "Revenue", [Total Revenue]) ORDER BY 'Date'[Year], 'Date'[Month Number]
